h1: How to Order Custom Drinkware from BOOM
lead: Choose an existing product or share a new cup idea. Send the quantity, artwork, packing, destination and arrival requirement to niles@boomdrinkware.com.
html:
Design and approval

We provide a free design proposal and visual mockup. Approve the artwork and sample arrangement, then define the product and packing version for the order.

Payment and shipment

Pay a 30% deposit and the remaining balance before shipment. We accept T/T, Western Union and Alipay; currencies and EXW, FOB Shenzhen, C&F or DDP terms are agreed for the order.
